families.page_title: Arsenic: health effects, incident management and toxicology
evidence_points: The official UKHSA page provides information on arsenic for use in responding to chemical incidents.
The page is published by the UK Health Security Agency on GOV.UK.
The publication was first published on 1 July 2014.
The GOV.UK record shows a latest update of 15 October 2024.
The publication provides general information, incident management and toxicological overview material.
The linked material describes health effects associated with exposure to arsenic.
The source provides substance-specific incident-response information rather than treating all chemical events as equivalent.
The official page was live-opened successfully on 31 July 2026 and retained its current GOV.UK publication title.
